Version 1
SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily("", "");
NOT DB_ARCANA_CardFamily("", "");
PROC_ARCANA_CardFamilies();

KBSECTION
// Card families: every card and every one of its upcast variants, linked to the card (its root). A cast event
// (UsingSpell, CastSpell, UsingSpellOnTarget) gives the name of the variant the character paid for (..._5), not
// the card's, so a rule that reacts to a card asks DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_ArcanaSpell, "<card>").
// Generated by gen_upcast_variants.pl (rewritten whole on every --apply): edit the generator, not this file.
//
// DBs (table, rebuilt by PROC_ARCANA_CardFamilies on a new game and on every load):
//   DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(Spell, Card)   read by every goal that reacts to a card.

//REGION Tables
// Cleared before it is filled: an old save keeps the rows of variants that no longer exist.
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_CardFamilies()
AND
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, _Card)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, _Card);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_CardFamilies()
THEN
